name: tune-threshold
program:
let noise : Int -> Int =
  fun i -> int_mod(i * 7919 + 104729, 10007)
in
let readings : [(Int, Int, Int)] =
  init(300, fun i ->
    (int_mod(noise(i), 4),
     int_mod(noise(i + 1), 50) + 1,
     int_mod(noise(i + 2), 20) + 5))
in
let station : (Int, Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun (s, _, _) -> s
in
let volume : (Int, Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun (_, v, _) -> v
in
let cost : (Int, Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun (_, _, c) -> c
in
let billed : [(Int, Int, Int)] -> [Int] =
  fun rows -> map(rows, fun r -> volume(r) * cost(r))
in
let subtotal : [Int] -> Int =
  fun amounts -> fold_left(amounts, fun (acc, n) -> acc + n, 0)
in
let all_amounts = billed(readings) in
let threshold = 100 in
let qualifying = filter(all_amounts, fun n -> n > threshold) in
let qualifying_total = subtotal(qualifying) in
qualifying_total
